title: Operational interpretation of the reverse sandwiched Renyi divergences in composite quantum hypothesis testing
summary: We study the Hoeffding regime of composite quantum hypothesis testing, in which each hypothesis is specified by a sequence of sets of quantum states. We establish quantum Hoeffding bounds under a set of structural assumptions, orthogonal to those of our previous framework.
